{{Quote|&hellip;Satine Kryze had been sent offworld as a child by her father, a mighty clan warlord, and she fell prey to the lies of the Jedi. After her father perished in the Great Clan Wars, she betrayed his memory by becoming the leader of the New Mandalorians.|[[Tor Vizsla]]|<ref name="TBHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>}}
'''Satine Kryze's father''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who served as the [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] of [[Clan Kryze/Legends|Clan Kryze]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading up to the [[Great Clan Wars/Legends|Great Clan Wars]]. As the fighting broke out across [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], he chose to send his daughter, [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine]], to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], in order to keep her safe and allow her to undergo [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] training.<ref name="ShadowConspiracy">''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]''</ref> Though renowned as a powerful [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]], Kryze eventually perished in the course of the Great Clan Wars. In a move that some saw as a betrayal of his memory, his daughter Satine later joined the pacifistic [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] sect upon her return to Mandalore, becoming the faction's [[Anti-Mandalore|leader]].<ref name="TBHC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The father of Duchess Satine Kryze was first mentioned in the [[2013]] young reader's book [[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy|''Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy'']], a tie-in to the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, [[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Jason Fry]] as a novelization of the show's [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] episodes "[[Revival (episode)|Revival]]," "[[Eminence (episode)|Eminence]]," "[[Shades of Reason]]," and "[[The Lawless]]."<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> Further mention of Kryze's father and his role in Mandalorian history came later that year, in the source booked entitled ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'', written by Fry in conjunction with [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Ryder Windham]].<ref name="TBHC" />
